title: is tickeron worth it?
author: NewspaperSimilar9734
selftext: I know there are no shortcuts in trading. But tickeron's AI trading bot looks interesting. Unfortunately they don't offer trial to try it out. And they seem to have two different subscriptions for their AI bot trading. I get 50% off email almost every day. So it looks suspicious. Has anyone tried this? Is it worth it?

comments.author: Trapped_Delta
comments.body:
Hey, i'm using it for quite some time and it's useful as a signal engine. As with everything, i wouldn't recommend to blindly copy everything you see, but it's a nice tool to confirm your bias or get fresh ideas for further examination.

While they probably don't offer trial for bots, you can try to open any bot page when the market is closed, all the stats and trades should be available, they're only hidden when the market is open.
